title: San Diego Private Yacht Charter on a Classic Sailboat
includes: Beer, white wine and soft drinks
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Boat is a traditional sailboat with wooden mast, gaff rigging, and classic decor
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Book the entire boat for your group — no strangers, no shared space, just your crew and Captain Phil on San Diego Bay.
Liberty is a classic 41-ft Friendship sloop skippered by a USCG-licensed captain with 55 years of sailing experience. Your private charter delivers the most personal way to experience San Diego from the water — calm, unhurried, and entirely yours.
Included: craft beer, California white wine, soft drinks, and packaged snacks.
Sail past the San Diego skyline, Coronado Bridge, and USS Midway at your own pace. Ideal for celebrations, anniversaries, and groups who simply want the boat to themselves.
All private charters are 2.5 hours. Paid marina parking available. Gratuity for the captain is appreciated and not included.
